name: ai-sdk-marketing-chain
title: Write marketing copy, then improve it

origin.source: Vercel AI SDK sequential processing workflow

comparison.purpose: Drafts a plain blurb for a product, scores it against quality criteria, and rewrites it once — original copy, rubric, and improved copy side by side, as an explicit XState machine.

starters: A refillable stainless-steel bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours.
An app that turns your grocery receipts into weekly recipes.
A standing desk that nags you, politely, when you have been sitting too long.
